---
title: "About"
---

![A Golden Retriever](golden_retriever.png)

This project investigates the relationship between activity levels, weight, and life expectancy in Golden Retrievers using a dataset of 10,000 observations.

This work was completed as part of Milestone 4 for Bayesian Data Science.
